``` r
                                                        nstart = 50)})

# compare whether things clustered together even if cluster labels are different, hierarchical cluster is rows and kmeans is columns, so order kmeans columns by max hierarchical cluster so that diagonal is the maximal matching, since cluster labels won't be the same but which muts go into which clusters should be similar and maximized in diagonal
# do across all kmeans and hclust calculated; first make matrix of hclust vs kmeans, get way to reorder cols to make diagonal maximum, reorder matrices per these cols, add rowsums total at ends of matrices, convert each matrix to df, rename 1x1 df because of how R named it
consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep <- 
  lapply(1:length(solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all),
         FUN = function(x) table(solecancerpos_clusters_all[, x], 
                                 solecancerpos_kmeansclust_all[[x]][["cluster"]]))

col_reordering <-
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep),
         FUN = function(x) replace(max.col(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]], 
                                           "first"), 
                                   duplicated(max.col(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]], 
                                                      "first")), 
                                   setdiff(1:ncol(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]]), 
                                           max.col(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]], 
                                                   "first"))))

consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep <- 
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep),
         FUN = function(x) (consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]])[,col_reordering[[x]]])

consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep <- 
  lapply(rapply(list(cbind(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[1]],
                           Total = consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[1]]),
                     lapply(2:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep), 
                            FUN = function(x) cbind(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]],
                                                    Total = rowSums(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]])))), 
                enquote, 
                how = "unlist"), 
         eval)

consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all <- 
  lapply(1:length(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep),
         FUN = function(x) as.data.frame(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all_prep[[x]]))

names(consensus_hclust_kmeans_solecancerpos_all[[1]]) <- gsub("V",

           mutate_at(vars(1:Total),

# calculate rand indices and adjusted rand indices across all dfs for clustering similarity for barplots
```

``` r
                       clustermethod = kmeansCBI,
                       scaling = FALSE, # data already provided as scaled so don't need to rescale
                       krange = max(solecancerpos_clusters),

                       iter.max = 10,
                       scaledata = FALSE,
                       seed = 1212,
                       count = FALSE)

barplot(bootres$bootmean, 
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylim = c(0, 1),
        names.arg = c(1:max(solecancerpos_clusters)),
        main = "Cluster stability",

        ylab = "Jaccard similarity",
        col = ifelse(bootres$bootmean < 0.6, # Jaccard < 0.6 is unstable cluster, shouldn't be trusted
                     "red",
                     "gray"),
        font.lab = 2,
        las = 1)

abline(h = 0.75, # Jaccard >= 0.75 is valid and stable cluster

       lwd = 2)
```

``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_cancer_pos_lm, 
                    trace = FALSE, 
                    test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Df,
                   AIC,
                   LRT)) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              # Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic == "TransactivationClass" ~ "Transactivation",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(`p-val` = `Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

# **Identifying Mutations Affecting Splicing** {#splicing}

$~$

$~$


``` r
# indicate whether patients have splicing and isoform positions affected
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice <- origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

origdbdefcancer_forsplice <- origdbdefcancer %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

breakdown_forsplice <- breakdown %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(Effect %in% c("splice", "intronic") | Codon_number %in% (c(40, 133, 160)),
                             "yes",
                             "no")) %>% 
  transform(Isoform = ifelse(is.na(Isoform),
                             "no",
                             Isoform))

# rename values in exon and intron column to follow typical intron # syntax instead of #-intron
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                                 "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                                 "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

origdbdefcancer_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbdefcancer_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                    "^(\\d+-)([a-z]+)", 
                                                    "\\2 \\1") %>% # put any numbers and dash at front to back of string with space
  gsub("-", 
       "", 
       .)

# "i" or "e" in front means mut w/i indicated intron or exon but no info on precise location, so  need to add e#exon and i#intron to each exon or intron counts too, particularly for sole pts
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^e([0-9]+)exon", 
                                                                 "exon \\1")

origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron <- str_replace(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice$ExonIntron,
                                                                 "^i([0-9]+)intron", 
                                                                 "intron \\1") # no i#introns in dataset but just for completeness

# make pivot tables for specific splice and other positions proportions across pts
solespliceperpos <- PivotTable$new()
solespliceperpos$addData(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice)
solespliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("Isoform") 
solespliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("ProtDescription", addTotal = FALSE) # don't keep overall totals
solespliceperpos$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct individuals",
                                   summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
solespliceperpos$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 2,
                                   orderBy = "calculation",
                                   sortOrder = "desc")
solespliceperpos$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table

multspliceperpos <- PivotTable$new()
multspliceperpos$addData(origdbjustmultcancersover100_forsplice)
multspliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("Isoform") 
multspliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("ProtDescription", addTotal = FALSE) # don't keep overall totals
multspliceperpos$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct individuals",
                                   summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
multspliceperpos$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 2,
                                   orderBy = "calculation",
                                   sortOrder = "desc")
multspliceperpos$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table

nonespliceperpos <- PivotTable$new()
nonespliceperpos$addData(breakdown_forsplice %>% subset(Unaffected == TRUE))
nonespliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("Isoform") 
nonespliceperpos$addRowDataGroups("ProtDescription", addTotal = FALSE) # don't keep overall totals
nonespliceperpos$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct individuals",
                                   summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
nonespliceperpos$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 2,

# fix cancer naming and transform as factor for stacked barcharts

  transform(Cancer = gsub("\\.",
                          " ",
                          Cancer))

solespliceintron_pivot_melted$Cancer <- factor(solespliceintron_pivot_melted$Cancer,
                                               levels = c(sort(unique(solespliceintron_pivot_melted$Cancer))[sort(unique(solespliceintron_pivot_melted$Cancer)) != "OTHER"],

# fix splice site naming and transform as factor for stacked barchart
solesplicepossite_pivot_melted <- solesplicepossite_pivot_melted %>% 
  # transform(Site = gsub("consensus\\.",
  #                       "",
  #                       Site)) %>%
  transform(Site = dplyr::case_when(Site == "consensus.SD" ~ "Consensus splice donor",
                                    Site == "consensus.SA" ~ "Consensus splice acceptor",
                                    Site == "no" ~ "Neither",

                     " individuals)")) %>% # divide down each col by last value i.e. total pts
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),

  dplyr::select(-Total)

# reorder cols such that pt/cancer is first and not muts immediately follow respective muts

  relocate(Patient)

  contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice[,sort(names(contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice))] %>% 
  relocate(Cancer)

# subtract final pt/cancer tally from each mut in its own vector, add to df and collapse rows to remove NAs, thus line up NAs where new subtracted values only go into other mut cols
contingency_germ_som_splice <- rbind(contingency_germ_som_splice,
                                     c(NA, (last(solespliceperpos_pivot$Total) - contingency_germ_som_splice[1,] %>% as.numeric()) %>% head(-1))) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(),
                   ~ na.omit(.x))) %>% 
  mutate(Total = last(solespliceperpos_pivot$Total))

# because need to subtract total minus each previous column, make intermediate df with all total pt numbers per cancer and subtract total from previous column to col of interest
blah <- left_join(contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice,
                  solesplicepercancerpos_pivot %>% # get total number of pts with each cancer
                    dplyr::select(-c(Isoform,
                                     Total,
                                     OTHER)) %>% 
                    last() %>% 
                    mutate(ProtDescription = "Total") %>%
                    remove_rownames() %>% 
                    column_to_rownames("ProtDescription") %>% 
                    t() %>% 
                    as.data.frame() %>% 
                    rownames_to_column("Cancer") %>% 
                    mutate(Cancer = paste0(Cancer,
                                           "_germline sole")),
                  by = "Cancer")

# define columns to be subtracted
columns_to_subtract <- colnames(blah)[grepl("_Not",
                                            colnames(blah))]

# subtract cols
blah[, columns_to_subtract] <- lapply(columns_to_subtract, 
                                      function(col) {
                                        index <- match(col, 
                                                       names(blah)) # index of current col
                                        blah[, "Total"] - blah[, index - 1] # total - prev col
                                      })
```

``` r
contingency_germ_som_splice <- rbind(contingency_germ_som_splice,
                                     contingency_som_germ_splice) %>% 
  arrange(Patient) %>% 
  na.omit()

contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice <- rbind(contingency_germ_som_cancers_splice,
                                             contingency_som_germ_cancers_splice) %>% 
  arrange(tolower(Cancer))

contingency_germ_som_cancers_overall_splice <- rbind(contingency_germ_som_cancers_overall_splice,
                                                     contingency_som_germ_cancers_overall_splice) %>% 
  arrange(tolower(Cancer))

contingency_germ_som_overallraw_splice <- left_join(contingency_germ_som_overallraw_splice,
                                                 contingency_som_germ_overallraw_splice,
                                                 by = "Isoform")

# then remove splice equaling Total, transpose with yes first then no, prop.test
(contingency_germ_som_overallraw_splice %>% 
    subset(Isoform != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("Isoform") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::prop.test(., 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)
```

``` r
# pairwise prop test to confirm if percent of splice muts overall in cancers and total differ, so need to make matrix of 2 cols, first is success and second is failures i.e. yes and no, and then send to function, don't need multiple hypothesis correction with p adjustment because these are independent tests made
(solesplicepercancer_pivot %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(OTHER)) %>% 
    subset(Isoform != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("Isoform") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::pairwise.prop.test(., 
                            p.adjust.method = "none")
```

``` r
# can also do general prop test to see overall if difference in percentages, not significant 
(solesplicepercancer_pivot %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(OTHER,
                     Total)) %>% 
    subset(Isoform != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("Isoform") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::prop.test(., 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)
```

``` r
top_splice_sole_gridprep <- condformat(pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                      filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                        "One") & Isoform == "yes") %>% 
                                      left_join(., 
                                                solespliceperpos_pivot %>% 
                                                  dplyr::select(c(ProtDescription, 
                                                                  Total)), 
                                                by = "ProtDescription") %>% 
                                      arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                      head(10) %>%
                                      mutate(Proportion = plyr::round_any(Calc * 100,
                                                                          0.01)) %>%
                                      dplyr::select(c(Label,
                                                      Proportion,
                                                      Total)) %>%
                                      dplyr::rename(Mutation = Label,
```

``` r
# in stats::prop.test(), x can equal a vector of successes (i.e., total number of yes) and n can equal a vector of trials (i.e., total number of cases)

# compare intronic overall between germline and somatic
stats::prop.test(x = c(55, 875), n = c(842, 12793), 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)
```

```

	2-sample test for equality of proportions with continuity correction

data:  c(55, 875) out of c(842, 12793)
X-squared = 0.0742, df = 1, p-value = 0.7853
alternative hypothesis: two.sided
95 percent confidence interval:
 -0.02096242  0.01481019
sample estimates:
    prop 1     prop 2 
0.06532067 0.06839678 
```

``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_age_splice_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(cancer_freq_splice_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

``` r
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_splice_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

``` r
barchart_pts_splice_none <- ggplot(pt_none_splice_df_ggplot %>% 
                                  subset(Isoform == "yes"),
                                aes(x = factor(Patient,
                                               levels = sort(unique(pt_none_splice_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                             decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,1,3))]), # none, sole, mult
                                    y = Calc, 
                                    fill = factor(Patient,
                                                  levels = sort(unique(pt_none_splice_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                                decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,1,3))]))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +   
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Calc * 100, 
                                               0.1),
                               "%")),
            color = "black",
            size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            vjust = -0.5,
            hjust = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = c(solesplice_pivot %>% subset(Isoform == "yes") %>% pull(Total),
                          multsplice_pivot %>% subset(Isoform == "yes") %>% pull(Total),
                          nonesplice_pivot %>% subset(Isoform == "yes") %>% pull(Total)
                          ) # original order in dataframe
                ),
            color = "white",
            size = 4,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            y = 0.005,
            hjust = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Germline Mutations \nin TP53 Affecting Splicing in Individuals") + 
  xlab("Patient type") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Patient type") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                     limits = c(0, plyr::round_any(pt_none_splice_df_ggplot %>% 
                                                     subset(Isoform == "yes") %>%
                                                     pull(Calc) %>%
                                                     max(),
                                                   0.12,
                                                   ceiling) * 1.0000001)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgray",
                               "#0072B2",
                               "#D55E00")) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,20, "mm"))
barchart_pts_splice_none
```

``` r
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Calc * 100,

  ggtitle("Proportion of Germline Mutations in TP53 Affecting Splicing in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  facet_wrap2(. ~ factor(Label,

              drop = FALSE, # ensure muts not in dataset still shown as blanks
              axes = "y") + # show all inner y axes labels too
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5), 
                     limits = c(0, ((pt_none_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%

                                                                              "M133R")) %>% 
                                       pull(Calc) %>% 
                                       max() %>% 
                                       plyr::round_any(0.02,
                                                       f = ceiling)) * 1.00001))) + 
  scale_x_discrete(
    #limits = rev, 
    expand = c(0,0),
    drop = FALSE) + # ensure muts not in dataset are still shown as blanks
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgray",
                               "#0072B2",
                               "#D55E00")) +
```

``` r
to_fit_all <- 1 - (sum(pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%

                                                         Patient)) %>%
                         pull(Calc)))

to_fit_sole <- 1 - (sum(pt_spliceperpos_df_ggplot %>%
```

``` r
    subset(!str_detect(Cancer, "OTHER|Other")) %>%
    subset(Isoform == "yes" & Label %in% c("T125T", 
                                           "M133T", 
                                           "M133R")), 
  aes(x = factor(Dataset,
                 levels = 
                   c(sort(unique(as.vector(germ_som_cancers_same_splice_ggplot$Dataset)))[!str_detect(sort(unique(as.vector(germ_som_cancers_same_splice_ggplot$Dataset))), 
                                                                                                      "OTHER|Other")]))
      ,
      y = Proportion, 
      fill = factor(Dataset,
                    levels = 
                      c(sort(unique(as.vector(germ_som_cancers_same_splice_ggplot$Dataset)))[!str_detect(sort(unique(as.vector(germ_som_cancers_same_splice_ggplot$Dataset))), 
                                                                                                         "OTHER|Other")])
      )
  )) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           position = position_dodge2()) + # to keep some space b/t barcharts in same mut
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Proportion * 100, 
                                               0.1),
                               "%")),
            color = "black",
            size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            vjust = -0.5,
            hjust = 0.5) +
  xlab("Dataset") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Dataset") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Germline vs Somatic Mutations \nAffecting TP53 Splicing in Individuals with Cancer") +
  facet_grid2(Tissue ~ factor(Label,
                              levels = c("T125T", 
                                         "M133T", 
                                         "M133R")),
              drop = FALSE, # ensure muts not in dataset still shown as blanks
              axes = "all", # show internal axes but without x labels
              remove_labels = "x", # show internal axes but without x labels
              #axes = "y"
  ) + # show all inner y axes labels too
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5), 
                     limits = c(0, ((germ_som_cancers_same_splice_ggplot %>% 
                                       subset(Isoform == "yes" & Label %in% c("T125T", 
                                                                              "M133T", 
                                                                              "M133R")) %>%
                                       pull(Proportion) %>% 
                                       max() %>% 
                                       plyr::round_any(0.04, 
                                                       f = ceiling)) * 1.00001))) + 
  scale_x_discrete(
    #limits = rev, 
    expand = c(0,0)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2",
                               "#D55E00"
                               #,
                               # "#CC79A7",
                               #                            "#E69F00",
                               #                            "#009E73",
                               #                            "#56B4E9",
                               #                            "#999999",
                               #"#000000"
                               #,
                               #"#F0E442",
                               #"#0072B2",
                               #"#D55E00"
  )) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30),
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        #legend.position = c(,), # c(0,0) bottom left, c(1,1) top-right within plot
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = margin(10,10,10,10, "mm")),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(5, "lines"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(1, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,32, unit = "mm"))
```

``` r
# boxplot of whether splicing affects ages of dx
sole_splice_age_boxplot <- ggplot(
  # origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
  #                                   dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                   Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                   Isoform,
  #                                                   Sex,
  #                                                   Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                   distinct() %>% # remove pts with mult muts where one has splice 
  #                                   subset(!(Individual_code %in% (origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
  #                                              dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                              Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                              Isoform,
  #                                                              Sex,
  #                                                              Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                              distinct() %>% 
  #                                              count(Individual_code) %>% 
  #                                              subset(n > 1) %>% 
  #                                              pull(Individual_code))))
  splicechisq_df %>% 
    subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label, 
                       "OTHER")),
  aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
      x = relevel(as.factor(Isoform), 
                  ref = "yes"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73","#0072B2","darkgray"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #"black"
  ),
  name = "Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 100)) +
  ylab("Age when diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("Mutation affecting splicing") +
  ggtitle("Ages of diagnosis in Individuals \nwith Mutations Affecting Splicing") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
```

``` r
top_splice_sole_damaging_gridprep <- condformat(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forsplice %>% 
                                               subset(ProtDescription %in% c("M133T",
                                                                             "M133R",
                                                                             "T125T")) %>%
                                               dplyr::select(c(ProtDescription, 
                                                               TransactivationClass,
                                                               SIFTClass,
                                                               DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                               BayesDel,
                                                               REVEL, 
                                                               Polyphen2,
                                                               AGVGDClass, 
                                                               DNEclass)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                                               dplyr::rename(Mutation = ProtDescription, 
                                                             `Transactivation Class` = TransactivationClass,
                                                             `SIFT Class` = SIFTClass, 
                                                             `DNE_LOF Class` = DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                             PolyPhen2 = Polyphen2,
                                                             `Align-GVGD Class` = AGVGDClass, 
                                                             DNE = DNEclass) %>%
                                               arrange(abs(parse_number(Mutation))) %>%
                                               replace(is.na(.),
                                                       "") %>% 
                                               distinct()) %>% 
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

top_splice_sole_damaging_grid <- grid.arrange(top_splice_sole_damaging_gridprep,
                                  top = textGrob("Selected p53 Mutants Tests or Predictions of Damaging Function",
                                                 hjust = 0.5,
                                                 gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional",
                                                                   "supertrans"))) %>% 
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   DNE_LOFclass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
                                             levels = c("Yes",

                                                        "No"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   DNEclass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>%

  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>% 
  mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                       levels = c("non-functional",
                                                  "partially functional",
                                                  "functional",
                                                  "supertrans"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  TransactivationClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   SIFTClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>% 
  mutate(DNE_LOFclass = factor(DNE_LOFclass, 
                               levels = c("DNE_LOF",
                                          "notDNE_LOF", 
                                          "notDNE_notLOF",
                                          "unclass."))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  DNE_LOFclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   Polyphen2)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
  mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                           levels = c("Yes",
                                      "Moderate",
                                      "No"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  DNEclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(splicechisq_df$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   AGVGDClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   BayesDel)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   REVEL)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional",
                                                                   "supertrans"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   SIFTClass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                                             levels = c("Yes",
                                                        "Moderate",
                                                        "No"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   DNEclass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(splicechisq_df$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform,
                                   AGVGDClass)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
# make df for comparisons of germ vs som
df_for_gt <- full_join(splicechisq_df_germline_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "germline sole"),
                       splicechisq_df_somatic_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(Isoform, TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "somatic"))
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                                             levels = c("Yes",
                                                        "Moderate",
                                                        "No"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   DNEclass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
                 label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9), 
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
# make df for comparisons of germ vs som
df_for_gt <- full_join(splicedf_matchsomatic_germline_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                         Cancer_Label,
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = Cancer_Label %>% str_to_sentence()) %>%
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("Adrenal cortical",
                                              "Adrenocortical",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "germline sole"),
                       splicedf_matchgermline_somatic_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                         match_label,
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = match_label %>% str_to_sentence()) %>%
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("\\,.*",
                                              "",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("Soft tissue sarcoma",
                                              "Soft tissues",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "somatic")) %>% 
  mutate(BayesDel = as.numeric(BayesDel)) %>% 
  mutate(REVEL = as.numeric(REVEL))
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   DNE_LOFclass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                       levels = c("non-functional",
                                                  "partially functional",
                                                  "functional",
                                                  "supertrans"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Cancer,
                  Dataset,
                  TransactivationClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   SIFTClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(DNE_LOFclass = factor(DNE_LOFclass, 
                               levels = c("DNE_LOF",
                                          "notDNE_LOF", 
                                          "notDNE_notLOF",
                                          "unclass."))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                  Cancer,
                  DNE_LOFclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   Polyphen2)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                           levels = c("Yes",
                                      "Moderate",
                                      "No"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                  Cancer,
                  DNEclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(df_for_gt$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   AGVGDClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                    Age_at_diagnosis,
                                    Sex,
                                    Cancer_Label)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis",
                              Cancer_Label ~ "Cancer")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                    Cancer_Label)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 label = list(Cancer_Label ~ "Cancer"),
                 sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                   Cancer_Label,
                   Age_at_diagnosis)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis")
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- splicechisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                   Cancer_Label,
                   Sex)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
                 #,

  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>%

  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(splicechisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>%
                   # mutate(Cancer_Label = as.character(Cancer_Label)) %>% 
```
``` r
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(Isoform, 
                                    Sex)), 
                 by = Isoform,
                 sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- breakdown_forsplice %>%
  mutate(cancer_freq_pt_type = factor(cancer_freq_pt_type,
                                      levels = c("none",
                                                 "sole",
                                                 "multiple"))) %>%
  subset(cancer_freq_pt_type %in% c("multiple", 
                                    "none")) %>%
  mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Sex,
                  cancer_freq_pt_type,
                  Isoform)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Individual_code)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = cancer_freq_pt_type, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Isoform,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

contingency_germ_som_splice_grid <- grid.arrange(contingency_germ_som_splice_gridprep,
                                                 top = textGrob("Contingency Table of Individuals with Selected Germline vs Somatic Mutations in TP53 and Cancer",
                                                                hjust = 0.5,
                                                                gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

# **Identifying Mutations Rescued by ATO** {#ATO}

$~$

$~$


``` r
# indicate whether patients have Rescuable by ATO mutations
origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  transform(ATO = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_rescued,
                         "yes",
                         "no")) %>% 
  mutate(ATO_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% mut_not_rescued, 
                          "no",

# calculate proportions of pts with Rescuable by ATO mutations by dividing down, remove total row and column, add pt numbers
soleATOperpos_pivot_calc <- soleATOperpos_pivot %>%
  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(soleATOperpos_pivot[nrow(soleATOperpos_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("One cancer (",
                             as.numeric(soleATOperpos_pivot[nrow(soleATOperpos_pivot), "Total"]),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  transform(Label = ifelse(ATO == "yes",
                           ProtDescription,
                           "Other")) %>%
  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total)

multATOperpos_pivot_calc <- multATOperpos_pivot %>%
  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(multATOperpos_pivot[nrow(multATOperpos_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("Multiple cancers (",
                             as.numeric(multATOperpos_pivot[nrow(multATOperpos_pivot), "Total"]),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  transform(Label = ifelse(ATO == "yes",

  transform(Patient = paste0("No cancer (",
                             as.numeric(noneATOperpos_pivot[nrow(noneATOperpos_pivot), "Total"]),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  transform(Label = ifelse(ATO == "yes",

  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(defATOperpos_pivot[nrow(defATOperpos_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("All with cancer (",
                             format(as.numeric(defATOperpos_pivot[nrow(defATOperpos_pivot), "Total"]), 
                                    big.mark = ",", 
                                    trim = TRUE),

  transform(Label = ifelse(ATO == "yes",

  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total)

soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_calc <- soleATOpercancerpos_pivot %>% # add num pts to cancer colnames
  rename_at(vars(3:8),
            ~ paste0(.,
                     " (",
                     soleATOpercancerpos_pivot[nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot), .],
                     " individuals)")) %>% # divide down each col by last value i.e. total pts
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
  mutate(Label = ifelse(ATO == "yes",
                        ProtDescription,
                        "Other")) %>%
  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total)
```
