``` r
solePATpercancer$addRowDataGroups("PAT")
solePATpercancer$addColumnDataGroups("Cancer_Label")
solePATpercancer$defineCalculation(calculationName = "Count of distinct individuals",
                                   summariseExpression = "n_distinct(Individual_code)")
solePATpercancer$sortRowDataGroups(levelNumber = 1,
                                   orderBy = "calculation",
                                   sortOrder = "desc")
solePATpercancer$sortColumnDataGroups(levelNumber = 1,
                                      orderBy = "calculation",
                                      sortOrder = "desc")
solePATpercancer$evaluatePivot() #doing this instead of renderPivot() which takes too long as it shows an actual pivot table, but we need this as a dataframe anyways for calculations later so we don't need to print a pivot table

# convert pivot tables to dfs
soleATO_pivot <- soleATO$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Total = `Count of distinct individuals`) %>%
  remove_rownames()

multATO_pivot <- multATO$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Total = `Count of distinct individuals`) %>%
  remove_rownames()

noneATO_pivot <- noneATO$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Total = `Count of distinct individuals`) %>%
  remove_rownames()

defATO_pivot <- defATO$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Total = `Count of distinct individuals`) %>%
  remove_rownames()

soleATOpercancer_pivot <- soleATOpercancer$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>%

                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>% 
  remove_rownames()

soleATOnot_pivot <- soleATOnot$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>%

                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>%

soleATOnotpercancer_pivot <- soleATOnotpercancer$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>%

                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>%

solePAT_pivot <- solePAT$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Total = `Count of distinct individuals`) %>%
  remove_rownames()

solePATpercancer_pivot <- solePATpercancer$asDataFrame(rowGroupsAsColumns = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(),
                ~ replace_na(.,
                             0))) %>% 
  remove_rownames()

# calculate proportions of pts with Rescuable by ATO muts by dividing down, remove total row and column, add pt numbers
soleATO_pivot_calc <- soleATO_pivot %>%
  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(soleATO_pivot[nrow(soleATO_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("One cancer (",
                             as.numeric(soleATO_pivot[nrow(soleATO_pivot), "Total"]),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total) 

multATO_pivot_calc <- multATO_pivot %>%
  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(multATO_pivot[nrow(multATO_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("Multiple cancers (",
                             as.numeric(multATO_pivot[nrow(multATO_pivot), "Total"]),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total) 

noneATO_pivot_calc <- noneATO_pivot %>%
  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(noneATO_pivot[nrow(noneATO_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("No cancer (",
                             as.numeric(noneATO_pivot[nrow(noneATO_pivot), "Total"]),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total)

defATO_pivot_calc <- defATO_pivot %>%
  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(defATO_pivot[nrow(defATO_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("All with cancer (",
                             format(as.numeric(defATO_pivot[nrow(defATO_pivot), "Total"]), 
                                    big.mark = ",", 
                                    trim = TRUE),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total) 

soleATOpercancer_pivot_calc <- soleATOpercancer_pivot %>% # add num pts to cancer colnames
  rename_at(vars(2:7),
            ~ paste0(.,
                     " (",
                     soleATOpercancer_pivot[nrow(soleATOpercancer_pivot), .],
                     " individuals)")) %>% # divide down each col by last value i.e. total pts
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
  subset(ATO != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total) 

soleATOpercancer_pivot_melted <- soleATOpercancer_pivot_calc %>% 
  reshape2::melt() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cancer = variable,
                Proportion = value)

soleATOnot_pivot_calc <- soleATOnot_pivot %>%
  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(soleATOnot_pivot[nrow(soleATOnot_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("One cancer (",
                             as.numeric(soleATOnot_pivot[nrow(soleATOnot_pivot), "Total"]),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  subset(ATO_not != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total) 

soleATOnotpercancer_pivot_calc <- soleATOnotpercancer_pivot %>% # add num pts to cancer colnames
  rename_at(vars(2:7),
            ~ paste0(.,
                     " (",
                     soleATOnotpercancer_pivot[nrow(soleATOnotpercancer_pivot), .],
                     " individuals)")) %>% # divide down each col by last value i.e. total pts
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                ~ .x/last(.x))) %>% 
  subset(ATO_not != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total) 

soleATOnotpercancer_pivot_melted <- soleATOnotpercancer_pivot_calc %>% 
  reshape2::melt() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cancer = variable,
                Proportion = value)

solePAT_pivot_calc <- solePAT_pivot %>%
  transform(Calc = Total/as.numeric(solePAT_pivot[nrow(solePAT_pivot), "Total"])) %>% 
  transform(Patient = paste0("One cancer (",
                             as.numeric(solePAT_pivot[nrow(solePAT_pivot), "Total"]),
                             " individuals)")) %>%
  subset(PAT != "Total") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Total) 

solePATpercancer_pivot_calc <- solePATpercancer_pivot %>% # add num pts to cancer colnames
  rename_at(vars(2:7),
            ~ paste0(.,
                     " (",
                     solePATpercancer_pivot[nrow(solePATpercancer_pivot), .],
                     " individuals)")) %>% # divide down each col by last value i.e. total pts
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                ~ .x/last(.x))) %>%

  dplyr::select(-Total) 

solePATpercancer_pivot_melted <- solePATpercancer_pivot_calc %>% 
  reshape2::melt() %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Cancer = variable,
                Proportion = value)

# rbind because same columns to make df for stacked barchart
pt_ATO_df_ggplot <- do.call(rbind,

# identify top germline muts in all, sole, mult pts (changed to just sole b/c that's most analyses)

# save these vectors to read into somatic cbioportal script for plots 
saveRDS(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
        file = paste0(table_path, "top_ATO_in_germline_vector.rds"))

saveRDS(top_muts_germline_vector,
        file = paste0(table_path, "top_muts_germline_vector.rds"))

# read in analogous vectors from somatic cbioportal dataset
top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector <- readRDS(file = paste0(analogous_somatic_path, "top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector.rds"))

top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector <- readRDS(file = paste0(analogous_somatic_path, "top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector.rds"))

# combine somatic cbioportal with germline muts so that all top muts in both are plotted at once
top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined <- unique(c(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                           top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined <- unique(c(top_muts_germline_vector,
                                            top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

# color code muts exclusively in germ or som, and keep common muts as black 
# setdiff syntax matters, here saying check which elements of first vector i.e germline muts not in second vector i.e the overlap of germline and somatic, would need to reverse terms for other way or do union(setdiff(1,2), setdiff(2,1)) to get what is not common in in either vector
# setdiff(x, y) returns the elements of x that are not in y but asymmetric difference, so setdiff(y, x) gives what elements of y are not in x and could be different answer

# which germline muts not in germ and som overlap i.e. exclusive to germline
top_ATO_combined_germ_exclusive <- setdiff(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                           intersect(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                                     top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

top_muts_combined_germ_exclusive <- setdiff(top_muts_germline_vector,
                                            intersect(top_muts_germline_vector,
                                                      top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

# which somatic muts not in germ and som overlap i.e. exclusive to somatic
top_ATO_combined_som_cbio_exclusive <- setdiff(top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector,
                                               intersect(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                                         top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

top_muts_combined_som_cbio_exclusive <- setdiff(top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector,
                                                intersect(top_muts_germline_vector,
                                                          top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector))

# set color of strip i.e. facet text and create named vectors of colors for plots
strip_text_color_topATO <- dplyr::case_when(top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined %in%  top_ATO_combined_germ_exclusive ~ "#56B4E9",
                                            top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined %in% top_ATO_combined_som_cbio_exclusive ~ "#CC79A7",
                                            top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined %in% intersect(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                                                                          top_ATO_in_somatic_cbioportal_vector) ~ "black",
                                            TRUE ~ "notyet")

strip_text_color_topmuts <- dplyr::case_when(top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined %in% top_muts_combined_germ_exclusive ~ "#56B4E9",
                                             top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined %in% top_muts_combined_som_cbio_exclusive ~ "#CC79A7",
                                             top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined %in% intersect(top_muts_germline_vector,
                                                                                            top_muts_somatic_cbioportal_vector) ~ "black",
                                             TRUE ~ "notyet")

strip_text_color_topATO_scale <- setNames(strip_text_color_topATO,
                                          top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined)

strip_text_color_topmuts_scale <- setNames(strip_text_color_topmuts,
                                           top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined)

# create conditional strips objects that can be added to facet plots and order by codon number
conditional_strips_ATO <- strip_themed(text_x = elem_list_text(colour = strip_text_color_topATO_scale[order(abs(parse_number(names(strip_text_color_topATO_scale))))], 
                                                               face = 'bold'))

conditional_strips_muts <- strip_themed(text_x = elem_list_text(colour = strip_text_color_topmuts_scale[order(abs(parse_number(names(strip_text_color_topmuts_scale))))],
                                                                face = 'bold'))

# confirm that facet colors ordering is the same as facet levels
table(top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined[order(abs(parse_number(top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined)))] == names(strip_text_color_topATO_scale[order(abs(parse_number(names(strip_text_color_topATO_scale))))])) # should be all 10 (now 9) TRUE
```

``` r
                                          colnames(contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO))]] <- 0

# reorder colnames per top ATO vector which will be how somatic is made, helping rbind later on
contingency_germ_som_ATO <- contingency_germ_som_ATO %>% 
  relocate(all_of(top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined),
           .after = 1)

contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO <- contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO %>% 
  relocate(all_of(top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined),
           .after = 1)

# add new cols with subtractions of pts/cancers with muts from total
# add new cols as placeholders
contingency_germ_som_ATO[c(paste0(colnames(contingency_germ_som_ATO)[-1],
                                  "_Not"))] <- NA 

contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO[c(paste0(colnames(contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO)[-1],
                                          "_Not"))] <- NA 

contingency_germ_som_ATO_addit[c(paste0(colnames(contingency_germ_som_ATO_addit)[-1],
                                  "_Not"))] <- NA 

contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO_addit[c(paste0(colnames(contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO_addit)[-1],
                                          "_Not"))] <- NA 

# reorder cols such that pt/cancer is first and not muts immediately follow respective muts
contingency_germ_som_ATO <- contingency_germ_som_ATO[,sort(names(contingency_germ_som_ATO))] %>% 
  relocate(Patient)

contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO <- 
  contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO[,sort(names(contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO))] %>% 
  relocate(Cancer)

contingency_germ_som_ATO_addit <- contingency_germ_som_ATO_addit[,sort(names(contingency_germ_som_ATO_addit))] %>% 
  relocate(Patient)

contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO_addit <- 
  contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO_addit[,sort(names(contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO_addit))] %>% 
  relocate(Cancer)

# subtract final pt/cancer tally from each mut in its own vector, add to df and collapse rows to remove NAs, thus line up NAs where new subtracted values only go into other mut cols
contingency_germ_som_ATO <- rbind(contingency_germ_som_ATO,
                                  c(NA, (last(soleATOperpos_pivot$Total) - contingency_germ_som_ATO[1,] %>% as.numeric()) %>% head(-1))) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(),
                   ~ na.omit(.x))) %>% 
  mutate(Total = last(soleATOperpos_pivot$Total))

contingency_germ_som_ATO_addit <- rbind(contingency_germ_som_ATO_addit,
                                  c(NA, (last(soleATOperpos_pivot$Total) - contingency_germ_som_ATO_addit[1,] %>% as.numeric()) %>% head(-1))) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(),
                   ~ na.omit(.x))) %>% 
  mutate(Total = last(soleATOperpos_pivot$Total))

# because need to subtract total minus each previous column, make intermediate df with all total pt numbers per cancer and subtract total from previous column to col of interest
blah <- left_join(contingency_germ_som_cancers_ATO,
                  soleATOpercancerpos_pivot %>% # get total number of pts with each cancer
                    dplyr::select(-c(ATO,

                    last() %>% 
                    mutate(ProtDescription = "Total") %>%
                    remove_rownames() %>% 
                    column_to_rownames("ProtDescription") %>% 
                    t() %>% 
                    as.data.frame() %>% 
                    rownames_to_column("Cancer") %>% 
                    mutate(Cancer = paste0(Cancer,
                                           "_germline sole")),
                  by = "Cancer")

# define columns to be subtracted
columns_to_subtract <- colnames(blah)[grepl("_Not",
                                            colnames(blah))]

# subtract cols
blah[, columns_to_subtract] <- lapply(columns_to_subtract, 
                                      function(col) {
                                        index <- match(col, 
                                                       names(blah)) # index of current col
                                        blah[, "Total"] - blah[, index - 1] # total - prev col
                                      })
```

``` r
# then remove ATO equaling Total, transpose with yes first then no, prop.test
contingency_germ_som_overallraw_ATO_proptestresult <- (contingency_germ_som_overallraw_ATO %>% 
                                                         subset(ATO != "Total") %>% 
                                                         remove_rownames() %>% 
                                                         column_to_rownames("ATO") %>% 
                                                         t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::prop.test(., 
                   alternative = "two.sided",
                   correct = TRUE)
contingency_germ_som_overallraw_ATO_proptestresult
```

``` r
breakdown_forATO$cancer_freq_pt_type <- relevel(breakdown_forATO$cancer_freq_pt_type,
                                                       ref = "none")
breakdown_forATO$Dead <- breakdown_forATO$Dead %>% 
  factor() %>% 
  relevel(ref = "FALSE")
```

``` r
# best models are binomial for follow up testing, so define clinical question with binary outcome, make logistic regressions where outcome is binomial, ensure variables used are not collinear with adjusted GVIF < sqrt(5) i.e. 2.23, then rerun regression on training fraction of data and predict on test fraction of data

# first, want to see if demographics predict ATO rescuable mutation status which is binary

# make binomial logistic regression
solecancer_ATO_binom_lm <- stats::glm(formula = ATO ~ Sex + Age_stratum + Cancer_Label + 
                                        #Population + 
                                        Region #+ 
                                      #SIFTClass + DNE_LOFclass + 
                                      #Effect 
                                      #+ Domain + Residue_function
                                      ,
                                      family = "binomial",
                                      data = origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
                                        drop_na(ATO,
                                                Sex,
                                                Age_stratum,
                                                Cancer_Label,
                                                #Population,
                                                Region,
                                                #SIFTClass,
                                                #DNE_LOFclass,
                                                #Effect
                                                #,
                                                #Domain,
                                                #Residue_function
                                        )
)
summary(solecancer_ATO_binom_lm)
```

``` r
# remove variables with adjusted GVIF > 2.23 i.e. sqrt(5) and likely collinear, and rerun modified model
# modifying model not needed, so create 80% test & 20% train fractions of data for predictive strength of model
set.seed(1212)
# Splitting the data into train and test
index <- caret::createDataPartition(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO$ATO, # vector of outcomes
                                    times = 1, # number of partitions to make
                                    p = 0.8, # fraction for training
                                    list = FALSE)
train_data <- origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO[index, ]
test_data <- origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO[-index, ]

# Training the model
solecancer_ATO_binom_training_lm <- stats::glm(formula = ATO ~ Sex + Age_stratum + Cancer_Label + 
                                        #Population + 
                                        Region #+ 
                                      #SIFTClass + DNE_LOFclass + 
                                      #Effect 
                                      #+ Domain + Residue_function
                                      ,
                                      family = "binomial",
                                      data = train_data %>% 
                                        drop_na(ATO,
                                                Sex,
                                                Age_stratum,
                                                Cancer_Label,
                                                #Population,
                                                Region,
                                                #SIFTClass,
                                                #DNE_LOFclass,
                                                #Effect
                                                #,
                                                #Domain,
                                                #Residue_function
                                        )
)
summary(solecancer_ATO_binom_training_lm)
```

``` r
# second, see if early age of diagnosis (binary) predicted by ATO status independent of other mut variables







# pairwise prop test to confirm if percent of ATO muts overall in cancers and total differ, so need to make matrix of 2 cols, first is success and second is failures i.e. yes and no, and then send to function, don't need multiple hypothesis correction with p adjustment because these are independent tests made
(soleATOpercancer_pivot %>% 
    dplyr::select(-c(OTHER)) %>% 
    subset(ATO != "Total") %>% 
    remove_rownames() %>% 
    column_to_rownames("ATO") %>% 
    t())[,c(2,1)] %>% 
  stats::pairwise.prop.test(., 
                            p.adjust.method = "none")
```

``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_age_ATO_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

$~$


``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(cancer_freq_ATO_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

$~$


``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_survival_ATO_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

$~$


``` r
t <- MASS::dropterm(solecancer_ATO_lm, 
               trace = FALSE, 
               test = "Chisq") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Characteristic") %>%
  arrange(`Pr(Chi)`) %>%
  transform(Sig = dplyr::case_when(`Pr(Chi)` < 0.001 ~ paste0("***"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.01 ~ paste0("**"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` < 0.05 ~ paste0("*"),
                                   `Pr(Chi)` >= 0.05 ~ paste0("NS"))) %>%
  transform(Characteristic = dplyr::case_when(Characteristic == "Effect" ~ "Type",
                                              Characteristic == "Residue_function" ~ "Feature",
                                              Characteristic == "SIFTClass" ~ "SIFT",
                                              Characteristic == "DNE_LOFclass" ~ "DNE",
                                              Characteristic %in% c("Short_topo",
                                                                    "Cancer_Label") ~ "Cancer",
                                              TRUE ~ Characteristic)) %>% 
  transform(Characteristic = ifelse(grepl("_",
                                          Characteristic),
                                    gsub("_",
                                         " ",
                                         Characteristic),
                                    Characteristic)) %>%
  #dplyr::rename(`Pr(Chi)` = `Pr.Chi.`) %>%
  gt() %>% 
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_column_labels())
```

``` r
# because multiple germline muts in pts, just in case percents != 100%, shrink other muts to fit expected %

                          subset(ATO == "yes" & grepl("Multiple",

to_fit_all <- 1 - (sum(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                         subset(ATO == "yes" & grepl("All", 
                                                     Patient)) %>%
                         pull(Calc)))

to_fit_sole <- 1 - (sum(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                          subset(ATO == "yes" & grepl("One", 
                                                      Patient)) %>%
                          pull(Calc)))

# plot zoomed in stacked barchart with adjusted %

                                          mutate(Calc_label = Calc) %>%
                                          mutate(Calc_label = dplyr::case_when(ATO == "no" & grepl("Multiple", 
                                                                                                   Patient) ~ to_fit_mult/nrow(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                                                                                 subset(ATO == "no" & grepl("Multiple",

                                                                               ATO == "no" & grepl("All",

                                                                                                                                subset(ATO == "no" & grepl("All",

                                                                               ATO == "no" & grepl("One",

                                                                                                                                 subset(ATO == "no" & grepl("One", 
                                                                                                                                                            Patient))),
                                                                               TRUE ~ Calc_label)), 
                                        aes(x = factor(Patient,
                                                       levels = sort(unique(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot$Patient),
                                                                     decreasing = TRUE)[order(c(2,3,1))]), 
                                            y = Calc_label, 
                                            fill = factor(Label,
                                                          levels = c((pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                                        arrange(-Calc) %>%

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(hue_pal()(length(c((pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%

                                                                  pull(Label) %>%
                                                                  unique()) != "Other"],
```

``` r
# creating df for manual p value addition to plot
stat.data <- germ_som_same_ATO_ggplot %>% 
    mutate(temp = (Patient %>% 
                       str_extract_all("\\([^()]+\\)") %>% # extract all text w/i parentheses
                       unlist %>% 
                       unname())) %>% 
    mutate(Dataset = paste0(Dataset,
                            " ",
                            temp)) %>% 
    subset(ATO == "yes" & Label %in% top_ATO_in_germline_vector
           #top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined
    ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Label, 
                  Dataset, 
                  Patient)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Patient, 
              values_from = Dataset) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(group1 = unique(germ_som_same_ATO_ggplot$Patient)[[1]], 
                group2 = unique(germ_som_same_ATO_ggplot$Patient)[[2]], 
                facet = Label) %>% 
  mutate(pval = case_when(facet == "R175H" ~ germ_vs_som_generally_proptest_R175H$p.value, 
                          facet == "G245S" ~ germ_vs_som_generally_proptest_G245S$p.value, 
                          facet == "R282W" ~ germ_vs_som_generally_proptest_R282W$p.value, 
                          facet == "M133T" ~ germ_vs_som_generally_proptest_M133T$p.value, 
                          facet == "P152L" ~ germ_vs_som_generally_proptest_P152L$p.value, 
                          facet == "R158H" ~ germ_vs_som_generally_proptest_R158H$p.value, 
                          TRUE ~ NA)) %>%
  mutate(label = symnum(pval,
                        cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
                        symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))) %>% 
  mutate(y.position = case_when(facet == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[1]] ~ germ_som_same_ATO_ggplot %>% 
                                  filter(Label == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[1]]) %>% 
                                  pull(Calc) %>%
                                  max() * 1.5, 
                                facet == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[2]] ~ germ_som_same_ATO_ggplot %>% 
                                  filter(Label == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[2]]) %>% 
                                  pull(Calc) %>%
                                  max() * 1.675, 
                                facet == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[3]] ~ germ_som_same_ATO_ggplot %>% 
                                  filter(Label == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[3]]) %>% 
                                  pull(Calc) %>%
                                  max() * 1.995, 
                                facet == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[4]] ~ germ_som_same_ATO_ggplot %>% 
                                  filter(Label == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[4]]) %>% 
                                  pull(Calc) %>%
                                  max() * 2.35, 
                                facet == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[5]] ~ germ_som_same_ATO_ggplot %>% 
                                  filter(Label == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[5]]) %>% 
                                  pull(Calc) %>%
                                  max() * 2.475, 
                                facet == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[6]] ~ germ_som_same_ATO_ggplot %>% 
                                  filter(Label == top_ATO_in_germline_vector[[6]]) %>% 
                                  pull(Calc) %>%
                                  max() * 2.525, 
                                TRUE ~ NA))
```

``` r
                     " individuals)")) %>% # divide down each col by last value i.e. total pts
```

``` r
  xlab("Dataset") +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))#,

                     ) +
  scale_x_discrete(

                                y.position = ((plot_df_germ_som_overall_ATO %>% 
                                                 pull(Proportion) %>%

                                                 plyr::round_any(0.05,
                                                                 f = ceiling)) * 1.075)), 
                     label = "label", 
                     size = 8,
                     bracket.size = 0.85,
                     tip.length = 0.075) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,

        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",

        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",

        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30), # increase space between legend and plot
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        #legend.position = c(,), # c(0,0) bottom left, c(1,1) top-right within plot
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,20, unit = "mm"))
```

``` r
                     filter(str_detect(Patient,

                     arrange(-Calc) %>%
                     head() %>% 
                     pull(Label) %>%
                     as.vector()) / n_distinct(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%

                                                                   "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                                 arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                                 pull(Label) %>%
                                                 as.vector())
vec <- c(prop,
         1 - prop)
raw <- c(n_distinct(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                      filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                        "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                      arrange(-Calc) %>%
                      head() %>% 
                      pull(Label) %>%
                      as.vector()),
         n_distinct(setdiff(unique(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                     filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                       "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                     arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                     pull(Label) %>%
                                     as.vector()),
                            unique(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                     filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                       "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                     arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                     head() %>% 
                                     pull(Label) %>%
                                     as.vector()))))

# make prevalence waterfall plots (base R barplots + abline at 1%) of all ATO muts in solecancer to justify why 1% chosen for focus in table
barplot(height = sort(as.numeric(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                 filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                                   "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                                 pull(Calc)) %>% na.omit(),
                      decreasing = TRUE),
        xaxs = "i", # remove space between left side of bars and y axis
        ylab = "Proportion of distinct individuals with cancer", 
        xlab = "", # "p53 mutation" text is cutting into labels otherwise
        main = "ATO-Rescuable p53 Mutations in Individuals with Cancer",
        names.arg = pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>% filter(str_detect(Patient, "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% arrange(-Calc) %>% pull(Label) %>% as.vector(),
        font.lab = 2,
        ylim = c(0, plyr::round_any(max(pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                                 filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                                   "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                                 pull(Calc),
                                        na.rm = TRUE),
                                    0.05,
                                    f = ceiling)),
        col = ifelse((pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                        filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                          "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                        arrange(-Calc) %>%
                        pull(Label) %>%
                        as.vector()) %in% (pt_ATOperpos_df_ggplot %>%
                                             filter(str_detect(Patient, 
                                                               "One") & ATO == "yes") %>% 
                                             arrange(-Calc) %>%
                                             head() %>% 
                                             pull(Label) %>%
                                             as.vector()),
                     "black",
                     "grey"),

        border = NA)
abline(h = 0.01,

legend("right",

axis(side = 1,
```

``` r
top_ATO_sole_damaging_gridprep <- condformat(origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
                                               subset(ProtDescription %in% c(top_ATO_in_germline_vector,
                                                                             "R158L")) %>%
                                               dplyr::select(c(ProtDescription, 
                                                               TransactivationClass,
                                                               SIFTClass,
                                                               DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                               BayesDel,
                                                               REVEL, 
                                                               Polyphen2,
                                                               AGVGDClass, 
                                                               DNEclass)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                                               dplyr::rename(Mutation = ProtDescription, 
                                                             `Transactivation Class` = TransactivationClass,
                                                             `SIFT Class` = SIFTClass, 
                                                             `DNE_LOF Class` = DNE_LOFclass, 
                                                             PolyPhen2 = Polyphen2,
                                                             `Align-GVGD Class` = AGVGDClass, 
                                                             DNE = DNEclass) %>%
                                               arrange(abs(parse_number(Mutation))) %>%
                                               replace(is.na(.),
                                                       "") %>% 
                                               distinct()) %>% 
  theme_grob(rows = NULL, 
             theme = ttheme_default(base_size = 10,
                                    core = list(padding = unit(c(15, 4), "mm")))) %>%
  condformat2grob(draw = FALSE)

                                  top = textGrob("Selected p53 Mutants Tests or Predictions of Damaging Function",

                                                 gp = gpar(fontface = "bold")))
```

``` r
                                                                                           ATO == "no" & Cancer == as.character(to_fit$Cancer[5]) ~ to_fit$Proportion[5]/nrow(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>%
```

``` r
                                                           subset(ATO == "yes" & Label %in% top_ATO_in_germline_vector
                                                                    #top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined
                                                                  ),
                                                         aes(x = factor(Dataset,
                                                                        levels = c(sort(unique(as.vector(germ_som_cancers_same_ATO_ggplot$Dataset)))[!str_detect(sort(unique(as.vector(germ_som_cancers_same_ATO_ggplot$Dataset))), 
                                                                                                                                                                 "OTHER|Other")])),
                                                             y = Proportion,
                                                             fill = factor(Dataset,
                                                                           levels = c(sort(unique(as.vector(germ_som_cancers_same_ATO_ggplot$Dataset)))[!str_detect(sort(unique(as.vector(germ_som_cancers_same_ATO_ggplot$Dataset))), 
                                                                                                                                                                    "OTHER|Other")]))
                                                         )) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           position = position_dodge2()) + # to keep some space b/t barcharts in same mut
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Proportion * 100, 
                                               0.1),
                               "%")),
            color = "black",
            size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            vjust = -0.5,
            hjust = 0.5) +
  xlab("Dataset") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Dataset") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of Rescuable by ATO Mutations in TP53 in Individuals with Cancer") + # different facet_wrap function which allows conditional strip i.e. facet formatting
  facet_grid2(Tissue ~ factor(Label,
                              levels = top_ATO_in_germline_vector[order(abs(parse_number(top_ATO_in_germline_vector)))]) #top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined[order(abs(parse_number(top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined)))])
              , # order by codon number so that colors match
              #strip = conditional_strips_ATO,
              axes = "all", # show internal axes but without x labels
              remove_labels = "x", # show internal axes but without x labels
              drop = FALSE) + # ensure muts not in dataset still shown as blanks
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 7), 
                     limits = c(0, ((germ_som_cancers_same_ATO_ggplot %>% 
                                       subset(ATO == "yes" & Label %in% top_ATO_in_germline_vector
                                                #top_ATO_germ_som_cbio_combined
                                              ) %>% 
                                       pull(Proportion) %>% 
                                       max() %>%
                                       plyr::round_any(0.12, 
                                                       f = ceiling)) * 1.000001))) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    #limits = rev, 
    expand = c(0,0),
    drop = FALSE) + # ensure muts not in dataset are still shown as blanks
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2",
                               "#D55E00"
                               # "#CC79A7",
                               #                            "#E69F00",
                               #                            "#009E73",
                               #                            "#56B4E9",
                               #                            "#999999",
                               #                            "#000000"
                               #,
                               #"#F0E442",
                               #"#0072B2",
                               #"#D55E00"
  )) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30), # increase space between legend and plot
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        #legend.position = c(,), # c(0,0) bottom left, c(1,1) top-right within plot
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = margin(10,10,10,10, "mm")),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(5, "lines"),
        #panel.spacing.y = unit(-10, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,35, unit = "mm"))
```

``` r
# make facet barchart on top muts germ/som across cancers
barchart_facet_keymutsifATO_cancers <- ggplot(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>% 
                                                subset(!str_detect(Cancer, "OTHER")) %>%
                                                subset(ATO == "yes" & Label %in% top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined),
                                              aes(x = factor(Cancer,
                                                             levels = c(sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer)))[!str_detect(sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer))), 
                                                                                                                                                     "OTHER")])),
                                                  # factor(Cancer,
                                                  #          levels = c(sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer)))[!str_detect(sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer))), 
                                                  #                                                                                                  "OTHER")], sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer)))[str_detect(sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer))), 
                                                  #                                                                                                                                                                                         "OTHER")])),
                                                  y = Proportion,
                                                  fill = factor(Cancer,
                                                                levels = c(sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer)))[!str_detect(sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer))), 
                                                                                                                                                        "OTHER")]))
                                                  # factor(Cancer,
                                                  #             levels = c(sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer)))[!str_detect(sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer))), 
                                                  #                                                                                                     "OTHER")], sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer)))[str_detect(sort(unique(as.vector(soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted$Cancer))), 
                                                  #                                                                                                                                                                                            "OTHER")]))
                                              )) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
           position = position_dodge2()) + # to keep some space b/t barcharts in same mut
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(plyr::round_any(Proportion * 100, 
                                               0.1),
                               "%")),
            color = "black",
            size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold",
            alpha = 0.75, # level of transparency (lower is more transparent)
            vjust = -0.5,
            hjust = 0.5) +
  xlab("Cancer") +
  ylab("Proportion of distinct individuals") +
  labs(fill = "Cancer") + 
  ggtitle("Proportion of ATO-Rescuable Hotspot Mutations in TP53 in Individuals with Cancer") + # different facet_wrap function which allows conditional strip i.e. facet formatting
  facet_wrap2(. ~ factor(Label,
                         levels = top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined[order(abs(parse_number(top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined)))]), # order by codon number so that colors match
              ncol = 5,
              strip = conditional_strips_muts,
              trim_blank = FALSE, # leave blank plots where muts not in dataset
              axes = "all", # show internal axes but without x labels
              remove_labels = "x", # show internal axes but without x labels
              drop = FALSE) + # ensure muts not in dataset still shown as blanks
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), 
                     expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6), 
                     limits = c(0, ((soleATOpercancerpos_pivot_melted %>% 
                                       subset(ATO == "yes" & Label %in% top_muts_germ_som_cbio_combined) %>% 
                                       pull(Proportion) %>% 
                                       max() %>%
                                       plyr::round_any(0.12, 
                                                       f = ceiling)) * 1.000001))) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    #limits = rev, 
    expand = c(0,0),
    drop = FALSE) + # ensure muts not in dataset are still shown as blanks
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#CC79A7",
                               "#E69F00",
                               "#009E73",
                               "#56B4E9",
                               "#999999",
                               "#000000"
                               #,
                               #"#F0E442",
                               #"#0072B2",
                               #"#D55E00"
  )) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        #legend.position = c(,), # c(0,0) bottom left, c(1,1) top-right within plot
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = margin(10,0,10,0, "mm")),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(6, "lines"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(-10, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,35, unit = "mm"))
```

``` r
# boxplot of whether Rescuable by ATO mutations affects ages of dx
sole_ATO_age_boxplot <- ggplot(
  # origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
  #                                   dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                   Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                   ATO,
  #                                                   Sex,
  #                                                   Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                   distinct() %>% # remove pts with mult muts where one has ATO 
  #                                   subset(!(Individual_code %in% (origdbjustsolecancersover100_forATO %>% 
  #                                              dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
  #                                                              Age_at_diagnosis,
  #                                                              ATO,
  #                                                              Sex,
  #                                                              Cancer_Label)) %>% 
  #                                              distinct() %>% 
  #                                              count(Individual_code) %>% 
  #                                              subset(n > 1) %>% 
  #                                              pull(Individual_code))))
  ATOchisq_df %>% 
    subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label, 
                       "OTHER")),
  aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
      x = relevel(as.factor(ATO), 
                  ref = "yes"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73","#0072B2","darkgray"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #"black"
  ),
  name = "Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 100)) +
  ylab("Age when diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("Rescuable by ATO Mutation") +
  ggtitle("Ages of diagnosis in Individuals \nwith Rescuable by ATO Germline Mutations") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional",
                                                                   "supertrans"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   SIFTClass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   DNE_LOFclass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(ATOchisq_df$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   AGVGDClass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>% 
  mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                       levels = c("non-functional",
                                                  "partially functional",
                                                  "functional",
                                                  "supertrans"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  TransactivationClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   SIFTClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>% 
  mutate(DNE_LOFclass = factor(DNE_LOFclass, 
                               levels = c("DNE_LOF",
                                          "notDNE_LOF", 
                                          "notDNE_notLOF",
                                          "unclass."))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  DNE_LOFclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   Polyphen2)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
  mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                           levels = c("Yes",
                                      "Moderate",
                                      "No"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                  Cancer_Label,
                  DNEclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(ATOchisq_df$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   AGVGDClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
               tbl_summary(by = ATO

               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Cancer_Label,
                                   REVEL)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional",
                                                                   "supertrans"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   SIFTClass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                                             levels = c("Yes",
                                                        "Moderate",
                                                        "No"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   DNEclass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                   #                    "OTHER")) %>% # do whole cohort to compare
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(ATOchisq_df$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   AGVGDClass)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
# make df for comparisons of germ vs som
df_for_gt <- full_join(ATOchisq_df_germline_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(ATO, 
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "germline sole"),
                       ATOchisq_df_somatic_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(ATO, TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "somatic"))
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
```
``` r
                                   DNE_LOFclass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
                                   DNEclass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```
