$~$


``` r
# make df for comparisons of germ vs som
df_for_gt <- full_join(ATOdf_matchsomatic_germline_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(ATO, 
                                         Cancer_Label,
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = Cancer_Label %>% str_to_sentence()) %>%
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("Adrenal cortical",
                                              "Adrenocortical",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "germline sole"),
                       ATOdf_matchgermline_somatic_only_yes %>% 
                         dplyr::select(c(ATO, 
                                         match_label,
                                         TransactivationClass:DNEclass)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = match_label %>% str_to_sentence()) %>%
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("\\,.*",
                                              "",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Cancer = gsub("Soft tissue sarcoma",
                                              "Soft tissues",
                                              Cancer)) %>% 
                         mutate(Dataset = "somatic")) %>% 
  mutate(BayesDel = as.numeric(BayesDel)) %>% 
  mutate(REVEL = as.numeric(REVEL))
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                                        levels = c("non-functional",
                                                                   "partially functional",
                                                                   "functional"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   TransactivationClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   SIFTClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Polyphen2)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                                             levels = c("Yes",
                                                        "Moderate",
                                                        "No"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   DNEclass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(df_for_gt$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   AGVGDClass)), 
                 by = Dataset,
                 label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9), 
        pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(TransactivationClass = factor(TransactivationClass, 
                                       levels = c("non-functional",
                                                  "partially functional",
                                                  "functional",
                                                  "supertrans"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Cancer,
                  Dataset,
                  TransactivationClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(TransactivationClass ~ "Transactivation Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   SIFTClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(SIFTClass ~ "SIFT Class"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(DNE_LOFclass = factor(DNE_LOFclass, 
                               levels = c("DNE_LOF",
                                          "notDNE_LOF", 
                                          "notDNE_notLOF",
                                          "unclass."))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                  Cancer,
                  DNE_LOFclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(DNE_LOFclass ~ "DNE/LOF Class") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = dplyr::case_when(Polyphen2 == "D" ~ "Probably damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "P" ~ "Possibly damaging",
                                                       Polyphen2 == "B" ~ "Benign",
                                                       TRUE ~ Polyphen2)) %>% 
                   mutate(Polyphen2 = factor(Polyphen2, 
                                             levels = c("Probably damaging",
                                                        "Possibly damaging",
                                                        "Benign"))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   Polyphen2)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(Polyphen2 ~ "PolyPhen2"),
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
  mutate(DNEclass = factor(DNEclass, 
                           levels = c("Yes",
                                      "Moderate",
                                      "No"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                  Cancer,
                  DNEclass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(DNEclass ~ "DNE") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- df_for_gt %>% 
                   mutate(AGVGDClass = factor(AGVGDClass, 
                                             levels = sort(unique(df_for_gt$AGVGDClass), 
                                                           decreasing = TRUE))) %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Dataset,
                                   Cancer,
                                   AGVGDClass)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = Dataset,
                           label = list(AGVGDClass ~ "Align-GVGD") 
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Age_at_diagnosis,
                                   Sex, 
                                   Cancer_Label)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis",
                              Cancer_Label ~ "Cancer")
                 #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                 ) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
chisq <- stats::chisq.test(as.matrix((ATOchisq_df %>% 
                                        subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                           "OTHER")) %>% 
                                        dplyr::select(c(Cancer_Label, 
                                                        ATO)) %>% 
                                        table())
                                     ))

# Contibution in percentage (%)
contrib <- 100*chisq$residuals^2/chisq$statistic

corrplot::corrplot(chisq$residuals, 
                   is.corr = FALSE,
                   tl.col = "black", # label colors
                   cl.cex = 1, # legend font size
                   cl.ratio = 0.75, # legend scale width
                   tl.srt = 45, # rotate top labels
                   cl.align.text = "l") # align numbers to side of legend
```

<img src="figures/corrplot-resid-ATO-vs-cancers-1.svg" alt="" width="100%" height="100%" style="display: block; margin: auto;" />

$~$


``` r
corrplot::corrplot(contrib, 
                   is.corr = FALSE,
                   tl.col = "black", # label colors
                   cl.cex = 1, # legend font size
                   cl.ratio = 0.75, # legend scale width
                   tl.srt = 45, # rotate top labels
                   col = colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))(200), # color of legend
                   cl.align.text = "l") # align numbers to side of legend
```

<img src="figures/corrplot-contrib-ATO-vs-cancers-1.svg" alt="" width="100%" height="100%" style="display: block; margin: auto;" />

``` r
t <- tbl_summary(breakdown_forATO %>%

                   distinct() %>%
                   dplyr::select(-c(Individual_code)),
                 by = ATO,
                 label = list(cancer_freq_pt_type ~ "Cancer frequency"),
                 sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df_sole_mult_none %>%
  dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                  Age,
                  type)) %>%
  mutate(type = relevel(factor(type),
                        ref = "sole")) %>% 
  tbl_strata(strata = type, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
               ) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                  Age_at_diagnosis,
                  Cancer_Label)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis")
                           #,
                           #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
                           ) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- ATOchisq_df %>% 
  subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                     "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(ATO, 
                   Sex,
                   Cancer_Label)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = Cancer_Label, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(workspace = 2e9),
                     pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
gt::gtsave(t, 
           file = paste0(fig_path, 
                         "sole-all-ATO-vs-age.png"),
           vwidth = 1800,
           expand = c(20,30,20,20))
```

$~$


``` r
t <- tbl_summary(ATOchisq_df %>% 
                   subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                      "OTHER")) %>%
                   mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                 Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                 TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
                   dplyr::select(c(ATO,
                                   Sex)), 
                 by = ATO,
                 sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
t <- breakdown_forATO %>%
  mutate(cancer_freq_pt_type = factor(cancer_freq_pt_type,
                                      levels = c("none",
                                                 "sole",
                                                 "multiple"))) %>%
  subset(cancer_freq_pt_type %in% c("multiple", 
                                    "none")) %>%
  mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Sex,
                  cancer_freq_pt_type,
                  ATO)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Individual_code)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = cancer_freq_pt_type, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

$~$


``` r
t <- breakdown_forATO %>%
  mutate(cancer_freq_pt_type = factor(cancer_freq_pt_type,
                                      levels = c("none",
                                                 "sole",
                                                 "multiple"))) %>%
  mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                TRUE ~ Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Sex,
                  cancer_freq_pt_type,
                  ATO)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Individual_code)) %>%
  tbl_strata(strata = cancer_freq_pt_type, 
             .tbl_fun = ~ .x %>% 
               tbl_summary(by = ATO,
                           sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) %>% 
               add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
               add_stat_label() %>% 
               bold_labels()) %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

# **Drawing Sole vs Multiple Pt Ages of Diagnosis Boxplots** {#solevsmultagesboxplots}

$~$


``` r
# create dataframe for boxplots with stats of sole pts vs mult pts first ages of dx to see if mult have cancers earlier
sole_vs_mult_ages_boxplot_df <- rbind(origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
                                        dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                                        Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                        Sex,
                                                        Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                                        distinct() %>% 
                                        transform(Patient = paste0("One cancer (",
                                                                   nrow(.),
                                                                   " individuals)")),
                                      origdbjustmultcancersover100 %>% 
                                        dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                                        Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                        Sex,
                                                        Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                                        distinct() %>% 
                                        transform(Patient = paste0("First of multiple cancers (",
                                                                   nrow(.),
                                                                   " individuals)")))

sole_mult_none_ages_boxplot_df <- full_join(breakdown %>% subset(Unaffected == TRUE) %>% 
                                              dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                                                              Age,
                                                              Sex,
                                                              Cancer_Label)) %>% 
                                              mutate(Cancer_Label = ifelse(Cancer_Label != "OTHER", 
                                                                           Cancer_Label, 
                                                                           "No cancer")) %>% 
                                              distinct() %>% 
                                              mutate(Patient = paste0("No cancer (",
                                                                      nrow(.),
                                                                      " individuals)")),
                                            sole_vs_mult_ages_boxplot_df %>% 
                                              dplyr::rename(Age = Age_at_diagnosis) %>% 
                                              distinct())
```

``` r
set.seed(1212) # for consistent jitter

# draw boxplots with stats of sole vs mult vs none first cancer ages or followup
sole_mult_none_ages_of_dx_followup_allpts_boxplot <- ggplot(sole_mult_none_ages_boxplot_df %>%
                                                              mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                                                                            Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                                                                            TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>% 
                                                              mutate(Patient = gsub(" \\(.*", "", Patient)) 
                                                            #%>% 
                                                            # subset(!str_detect(Cancer_Label,
                                                            #                    "OTHER"))
                                                            ,
                                                            aes(y = Age,
                                                                x = # Patient
                                                                  relevel(as.factor(Patient),
                                                                          ref = "One cancer")
                                                            )
) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = stat_box_data, 
               geom = "text", 
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = 0.1) + 
    stat_compare_means(paired = FALSE,
                       label.y = 142) + # Add global p-value
    geom_pwc(method = "dunn_test", # stat_compare_means w/ comparisons for Kruskal Wallis does not show p-adj
             p.adjust.method = "BH", # thus must manually add pairwise Dunn with BH adjustment
             bracket.nudge.y = 0.2, # nudge brackets by fraction of total height
             vjust = 0.3, # decrease gaps between labels and brackets
             tip.length = 0.02, # set length of tips on brackets
             size = 0.5, # change width of bracket lines
             label.size = 4, # change size of label text
             step.increase = 0.1, # decrease gaps between brackets
             hide.ns = TRUE,
             label = "p.adj.signif") + # to just show stars for significance
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off"
                  # , # prevent y-axis extending when brackets added so brackets drawn outside plot
                  # ylim = c(0, 100)
                  ) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Cancer_Label,
                  shape = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon","#D55E00","#009E73", "black", "#0072B2","slategray", "purple"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #
  ),
  name = "Cancer") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7
                     # ,
                     # limits = c(0, 150)
                     ) +
  ylab("Age when (first) diagnosed or at last follow up (years)") +
  xlab("Individuals") +
  ggtitle("Ages of (first) diagnoses or last follow up \nin Individuals with Cancer") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
```

``` r
                                                                          ref = "yes"),
                                                                x = 
                                                                  relevel(as.factor(Isoform),
                                                                          ref = "yes")
                                                            )
) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = stat_box_data, 
               geom = "text", color = "black",
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = 0.1) + 
  facet_wrap2(. ~ relevel(as.factor(type), ref = "sole"),
              ncol = 3,
              axes = "all", # show internal axes but without x labels
              remove_labels = "x") + # show internal axes but without x labels
    geom_pwc(method = "wilcox_test", # stat_compare_means w/ comparisons does not show p-adj
             p.adjust.method = "BH", # thus must manually add pairwise wilcox with BH adjustment
             bracket.nudge.y = 0.2, # nudge brackets by fraction of total height
             vjust = 0.3, # decrease gaps between labels and brackets
             tip.length = 0.02, # set length of tips on brackets
             size = 0.5, # change width of bracket lines
             label.size = 4, # change size of label text
             step.increase = 0.1, # decrease gaps between brackets
             hide.ns = TRUE,
             label = "p.adj.signif") + # to just show stars for significance
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Isoform),
              width = 0.25,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.45, 
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(#"maroon",
                                "#0072B2", "darkgray" #, "#D55E00"
                                #,"#009E73", "black", "slategray", "purple"
                                #,
                                #"purple"
                                #
  ),
  name = "Isoform-altering") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 150)
                     ) +
  ylab("Age when (first) diagnosed or \nat last follow up (years)") +
  xlab("Isoform-altering") +
  ggtitle("Ages of (first) diagnoses or last follow up in Individuals with Cancer") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   hjust = 1, 
                                   vjust = 1), 
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12), 
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  face = "bold",
                                  size = 14),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(10,0,0,0), units = "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,10,0,0), units = "mm")),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  margin = margin(0,0,10,0, "mm")),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    face = "bold",
                                    size = 14),
        legend.box.spacing = margin(30), # increase space between legend and plot
        legend.justification = "top", # put legend in top right of plot
        #legend.position = c(,), # c(0,0) bottom left, c(1,1) top-right within plot
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = margin(10,10,10,10, "mm")),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(5, "lines"),
        #panel.spacing.y = unit(-10, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,35, unit = "mm"))
```

``` r
# df for Kaplan-Meier survival of certain muts i.e. age for follow up, death noted, specific muts examined
KMdf <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>%
  subset(ProtDescription %in% c("R248Q",
                                "G245S",
                                "R248W")) %>%
  mutate(Dead_KM = ifelse(Dead == "true",
                          1,
                          0)) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Dead, 
                  Dead_KM,
                  # Age, # at follow up but not annotated for all patients
                  Age_at_diagnosis,
                  # Age_dx_follow,
                  ProtDescription,
  )) %>%
  mutate_at(c('ProtDescription'),
            as.factor) %>%
  distinct() 

KMdf$ProtDescription <- relevel(KMdf$ProtDescription,
                                ref = "R248Q")


# want to now see that if specific ACC-enriched mutations but did not have ACC first, how likely are they to get ACC at some point? thus, retain age of last cancer dx in mult pts, 
curvedf_mult <- origdbmultcancer %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Individual_code,
                  Age_at_diagnosis,
                  Sex,
                  Short_topo,
                  ProtDescription,
                  cancer_incidence)) %>% 
  transform(ACCfirst = ifelse(cancer_incidence == 1 & Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma",
                              "ACC-first",
                              "Other-first")) %>% # carry over to all pts' entries
  transform(ACCfirst = ifelse(Individual_code %in% (.[which(.$ACCfirst == "ACC-first"),
                                                      "Individual_code"]),
                              "ACC-first",
                              ACCfirst)) %>% 
  transform(ACC = ifelse(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma",
                         1,
                         0)) %>% # carry over to all pts' entries
  transform(ACC = ifelse(Individual_code %in% (.[which(.$ACC == 1),
                                                 "Individual_code"]),
                         1,
                         ACC)) %>% 
  transform(Mutation = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% c("T125T",
                                                     "P152L",
                                                     "R158H"),
                              "T125T, P152L, R158H",
                              "Other-mut")) %>% # carry over to all pts' entries
  transform(Mutation = ifelse(Individual_code %in% (.[which(.$Mutation == "T125T, P152L, R158H"),
                                                      "Individual_code"]),
                              "T125T, P152L, R158H",
                              Mutation)) %>% 
  group_by(Individual_code) %>% # get latest cancer for each pt rows only
  slice(which.max(cancer_incidence)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Age_at_diagnosis,
                  ACC,
                  Mutation,
                  Sex,
                  ACCfirst)) %>%
  mutate_at(c('Mutation',
              'Sex',
              'ACCfirst'),
            as.factor)
```

``` r
# since T125T, P152L, and R158H lead to a higher risk to develop ACC, want to see if they also associate with earlier age of dx for ACC
t <- tbl_summary(origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
                   subset(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma") %>% 
                   mutate(keymuts_or_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% c("T125T",
                                                                         "P152L",
                                                                         "R158H"),
                                                  "yes",
                                                  "no")) %>% 
                   distinct() %>% 
                   dplyr::select(c(Age_at_diagnosis,
                                   keymuts_or_not)), 
                 by = keymuts_or_not,
                 label = list(Age_at_diagnosis ~ "Age of cancer diagnosis")
  #,
                 #sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")
  ) %>% 
  add_p(pvalue_fun = pvalue_with_stars) %>% 
  add_stat_label() %>% 
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt()
t
```

``` r
# define df for plot
df_cluster_age_plot <- origdbjustsolecancersover100 %>% 
  subset(Short_topo == "Adrenal cortical carcinoma") %>% 
  mutate(keymuts_or_not = ifelse(ProtDescription %in% c("T125T",
                                                        "P152L",
                                                        "R158H"),
                                 "T125T, P152L, or R158H",
                                 "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(Sex = dplyr::case_when(Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
                                Sex == "M" ~ "Male",
                                TRUE ~ "notyet")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  dplyr::select(c(Age_at_diagnosis,
                  keymuts_or_not,
                  Sex))

# plot
set.seed(1212) # for consistent jitter
ACC_sole_clustermuts_vs_age_boxplot <- ggplot(df_cluster_age_plot,
                                              aes(y = Age_at_diagnosis,
                                                  x = relevel(as.factor(keymuts_or_not), 
                                                              ref = "T125T, P152L, or R158H"))) + 
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", # to put bars at end of IQRs
               width = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = stat_box_data, 
               geom = "text", 
               hjust = 0.5,
               vjust = 0.1) + 
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                     paired = FALSE,
                     hjust = -0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Sex),
              width = 0.3,
              height = 0,
              alpha = 0.5,
              seed = 1212,
              size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("maroon", 
                                "#0072B2"), 
                     labels = c("F" = "Female",
                                "M" = "Male"),
                     name = "Sex") + 
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 7,
                     limits = c(0, 60)) +
  ylab("Age when diagnosed (years)") +
  xlab("p53 mutant") +
  ggtitle("Ages of diagnoses in Individuals with ACC") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                 size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 14,
                                  face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = unit(c(5,0,0,0), "mm")),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = unit(c(0,5,0,0), "mm")),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                    size = 14,
                                    face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(color = "black",
                                  size = 16,
                                  face = "bold",
                                  margin = unit(c(0,0,5,0), "mm"),
                                  hjust = 0.5))
```

``` r
# forest plot of Cox proportional hazard model of predictors tested in time to event
# install this fork to survminer to allow very large or small HR and CIs to plot
detach("package:survminer", unload = TRUE)
pacman::p_load_gh("rschauner/survminer") #remotes::install_github("rschauner/survminer")
# library(survminer)

# change function to allow proper plotting
# trace(ggforest, edit = TRUE) and copy and paste current function code to remove Error in `[.data.frame`(data, , var, with = FALSE) : unused argument (with = FALSE)
ggforest2 <- function (model, 
                       data = NULL, 
                       main = "Hazard ratio", 
                       cpositions = c(0.02,                                    
                                      0.22, 
                                      0.4), 
                       fontsize = 0.7,
                       refLabel = "reference", 
                       noDigits = 2){
  conf.high <- conf.low <- estimate <- NULL
  stopifnot(inherits(model, 
                     "coxph"))
  data <- survminer:::.get_data(model, 
                                data = data)
  terms <- attr(model$terms, "dataClasses")[-1]
  coef <- as.data.frame(broom::tidy(model,
                                    conf.int = TRUE))
  gmodel <- broom::glance(model)
  allTerms <- lapply(seq_along(terms), 
                     function(i) {
    var <- names(terms)[i]
    if (terms[i] %in% c("factor", 
                        "character")) {
      adf <- as.data.frame(table(data[, var])) # removed with = FALSE here
      cbind(var = var, 
            adf, 
            pos = 1:nrow(adf))
    }
    else if (terms[i] == "numeric") {
      data.frame(var = var, 
                 Var1 = "", 
                 Freq = nrow(data), 
                 pos = 1)
    }
    else {
      vars <- grep(paste0("^", 
                          var, 
                          "*."), 
                   coef$term, 
                   value = TRUE)
      data.frame(var = vars, 
                 Var1 = "", 
                 Freq = nrow(data), 
                 pos = seq_along(vars))
    }
  })
  allTermsDF <- do.call(rbind, 
                        allTerms)
  colnames(allTermsDF) <- c("var", 
                            "level", 
                            "N", 
                            "pos")
  inds <- apply(allTermsDF[, 1:2],
                1, 
                paste0, 
                collapse = "")
  rownames(coef) <- gsub(coef$term, 
                         pattern = "`", 
                         replacement = "")
  toShow <- cbind(allTermsDF, coef[inds, ])[, c("var", 
                                                "level", 
                                                "N", 
                                                "p.value", 
                                                "estimate", 
                                                "conf.low", 
                                                "conf.high", 
                                                "pos")]
  toShowExp <- toShow[, 5:7]
  toShowExp[is.na(toShowExp)] <- 0
  toShowExp <- format(exp(toShowExp), 
                      digits = noDigits)
  toShowExpClean <- data.frame(toShow, 
                               pvalue = signif(toShow[, 4],
                                               noDigits + 1),
                               toShowExp)
  toShowExpClean$stars <- paste0(round(toShowExpClean$p.value, 
                                       noDigits + 1), 
                                 " ", 
                                 ifelse(toShowExpClean$p.value < 0.05, 
                                        "*", 
                                        ""), 
                                 ifelse(toShowExpClean$p.value < 0.01, 
                                        "*",
                                        ""), 
                                 ifelse(toShowExpClean$p.value < 0.001, 
                                        "*", 
                                        ""))
  toShowExpClean$ci <- paste0("(", 
                              toShowExpClean[, "conf.low.1"], 
                              " - ", 
                              toShowExpClean[, "conf.high.1"], 
                              ")")
  toShowExpClean$estimate.1[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- refLabel
  toShowExpClean$stars[which(toShowExpClean$p.value < 0.001)] <- "<0.001 ***"
  toShowExpClean$stars[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- ""
  toShowExpClean$ci[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- ""
  toShowExpClean$estimate[is.na(toShowExpClean$estimate)] <- 0
  toShowExpClean$var <- as.character(toShowExpClean$var)
  toShowExpClean$var[duplicated(toShowExpClean$var)] <- ""
  toShowExpClean$N <- paste0("(N=", toShowExpClean$N, ")")
  toShowExpClean <- toShowExpClean[nrow(toShowExpClean):1, 
  ]
  ci_h <- toShowExpClean$conf.high[is.finite(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.high.1))]
  ci_l <- toShowExpClean$conf.low[!near(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.low.1), 
                                        0)]
  toShowExpClean$conf.high[is.infinite(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.high.1))] <- max(ci_h, 
                                                                                       na.rm = TRUE)
  toShowExpClean$conf.low[near(as.numeric(toShowExpClean$conf.low.1), 
                               0)] <- min(ci_l, 
                                          na.rm = TRUE)
  rangeb <- range(toShowExpClean$conf.low, toShowExpClean$conf.high, 
                  na.rm = TRUE)
  breaks <- axisTicks(rangeb/2,
                      log = TRUE,
                      nint = 7)
  rangeplot <- rangeb
  rangeplot[1] <- rangeplot[1] - diff(rangeb)
  rangeplot[2] <- rangeplot[2] + 0.15 * diff(rangeb)
  width <- diff(rangeplot)
  y_variable <- rangeplot[1] + cpositions[1] * width
  y_nlevel <- rangeplot[1] + cpositions[2] * width
  y_cistring <- rangeplot[1] + cpositions[3] * width
  y_stars <- rangeb[2]
  x_annotate <- seq_len(nrow(toShowExpClean))
  annot_size_mm <- fontsize * as.numeric(grid::convertX(unit(theme_get()$text$size, 
                                                             "pt"), 
                                                        "mm"))
  p <- ggplot(toShowExpClean, 
              aes(seq_along(var),
                  exp(estimate))) + 
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = seq_along(var) - 0.5, 
                  xmax = seq_along(var) +  0.5, 
                  ymin = exp(rangeplot[1]), 
                  ymax = exp(rangeplot[2]), 
                  fill = ordered(seq_along(var)%%2 + 1))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FFFFFF33", 
                                 "#00000033"), 
                      guide = "none") + 
    geom_point(pch = 15,
               size = 4) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = exp(conf.low),       
                      ymax = exp(conf.high)), 
                  width = 0.15) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1,         
               linetype = 3) +
    coord_flip(ylim = exp(rangeplot)) + 
    ggtitle(main) + 
    scale_y_log10(name = "",
                  labels = sprintf("%g", 
                                   breaks), 
                  expand = c(0.02,
                             0.02),
                  breaks = breaks) + 
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(), 
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(), 
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "none", 
          panel.border = element_blank(), 
          axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
          axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
          axis.text = element_text(color = "black",
                                   size = 14), 
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                    size = 18,
                                    face = "bold",
                                    color = "black")) + 
    xlab("") + 
    annotate(geom = "text", 
             x = x_annotate,
             y = exp(y_variable), 
             label = toShowExpClean$var, 
             fontface = "bold", 
             hjust = 0, 
             size = annot_size_mm) + 
    annotate(geom = "text",
             x = x_annotate, 
             y = exp(y_nlevel), 
             hjust = 0, 
             label = toShowExpClean$level, 
             vjust = -0.1,
             size = annot_size_mm) + 
    annotate(geom = "text", 
             x = x_annotate, 
             y = exp(y_nlevel), 
             label = toShowExpClean$N, 
             fontface = "italic", 
             hjust = 0, 
             vjust = ifelse(toShowExpClean$level == "", 
                            0.5, 
                            1.1), 
             size = annot_size_mm) + 
    annotate(geom = "text",          
             x = x_annotate, 
             y = exp(y_cistring),
             label = toShowExpClean$estimate.1,     
             size = annot_size_mm, 
             vjust = ifelse(toShowExpClean$estimate.1 == "reference", 
                            0.5, 
                            -0.1)) + 
    annotate(geom = "text",  
             x = x_annotate, 
             y = exp(y_cistring), 
             label = toShowExpClean$ci,       
             size = annot_size_mm, 
             vjust = 1.1, 
             fontface = "italic") + 
    annotate(geom = "text", 
             x = x_annotate,
             y = exp(y_stars), 
             label = toShowExpClean$stars, 
             size = annot_size_mm, 
             hjust = -0.2,
             fontface = "italic") + 
    annotate(geom = "text", 
             x = 0.5, 
             y = exp(y_variable),
             label = paste0("# Events: ", 
                            gmodel$nevent, 
                            "; Global p-value (Log-Rank): ", 
                            format.pval(gmodel$p.value.log, 
                                        eps = ".001"), 
                            " \nAIC: ", 
                            round(gmodel$AIC, 2), 
                            "; Concordance Index: ", 
                            round(gmodel$concordance, 
                                  2)), 
             size = annot_size_mm,
             hjust = 0, 
             vjust = 1.2, 
             fontface = "italic")
  gt <- ggplot_gtable(ggplot_build(p))
  gt$layout$clip[gt$layout$name == "panel"] <- "off"
  ggpubr::as_ggplot(gt)
}
```

At the end of the page are references for all packages and papers referenced, in APA style. The following code allows for the automatic compilation of package references, while papers are manually inputted into a germlinepapers.bib file. Papers are added in the Visual editor by DOI and included as in-text citations.

$~$


``` r
knitr::write_bib(c(.packages()), 
                 file = paste0(table_path, "germlinepkgs.bib"))
```

$~$
